take: Per Anaheim's announcement, the Ducks assigned F Nico Myatovic to San Diego (AHL) and activated F Troy Terry from injured reserve. Myatovic had played four games as a third-liner at 9:52 a night, with no points and a 15.4% share of expected goals (the quality of chances) at five-on-five. ANA also did worse than usual with him on the ice, down 29.9 percentage points. Going by coach usage, Jeff Malott (9:47 a night) is next in line for those minutes. We have no numbers on Terry in this data.
